sanskrit_verse:
भद्रासनमधिष्ठाय संवीताङ्गः समाहितः ।
प्रणम्य लोकपालेभ्यः कार्यदर्शनमारभेत् ॥४८॥
transliteration:
bhadrāsanam adhiṣṭhāya saṃvītāṅgaḥ samāhitaḥ |
praṇamya lokapālebhyaḥ kāryadarśanam ārabhet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Having taken seat upon the auspicious throne, fully composed and clothed in integrity, one shall commence the observation of duties after saluting the guardians of the worlds.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from alignment with cosmic order
Capacity-based responsibility begins with inner stillness
Restoration logic requires recognition of universal guardianship
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent.is_seated_on_bhadrāsana AND body_is_covered_integrally AND mind_is_composed THEN duty_observation_permitted
GUARDIAN ACKNOWLEDGMENT IS NECESSARY FOR LEGAL CONTINUITY
supreme_court_application: At the highest judicial level, any ruling must originate from a state of seated authority (bhadrāsana), bodily composure (saṃvītāṅga), mental equanimity (samāhitaḥ), and reverence to universal custodians. This ensures that decisions stem not from individual will but from alignment with dharma-bearing cosmos.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causality through correct posture, breath control, and invocation of higher forces—thus ensuring actions arise from truth-consciousness rather than reactive impulse. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential unfolding: seat → attire → focus → salute → vision → act. There is no punitive element; all steps are preparatory for right seeing and being.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Seat Alignment Protocol: Ensure physical posture supports energetic coherence
Integrity Clothing Process: Realign outer conduct with inner truth
Samādhi Reset Procedure: Return mind to still point before proceeding
Lokapāla Salutation Cycle: Acknowledge governing consciousness fields
Duty Vision Activation: Initiate lawful perception only post-complete preparation
final_declaration: By the sovereign authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, source of all dharma, this directive is executed without exception. Justice flows solely for restoration, never punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates reality.
